# A user told in later cannot decrypt the older logs, so the history walk stops
# there. That is no failure, but it is said: the check did not reach init.

sesam-repo admin base.txt new.txt

cp $TMPDIR/base.txt s
exec sesam add s --group dev
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'add s'

exec sesam tell --user bob --recipient $BOB_PUBKEY --group dev
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'tell bob'

exec sesam verify --truncate
stderr 'Audit log history: ok'
! stderr 'only checked down to'

env SESAM_ID=$BOB_KEY
exec sesam verify --truncate
stderr 'Audit log history: ok'
stderr 'Audit log history: only checked down to commit [0-9a-f]+ - your identity cannot read the logs before'

# The pre-commit hook runs the same walk but keeps quiet about it.
exec sesam reveal
cp $TMPDIR/new.txt s
exec sesam seal
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'bob edits s'
! stderr 'only checked down to'

-- base.txt --
S=BASE
-- new.txt --
S=NEW
